text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Early retirement plan would cost Bahrain's Pension Fund Commission 346 million dinars over 20 years.
- A regional advertising training centre to be set up in Bahrain.
- Large cut in foreign labour in Bahrain will not harm Bahrain's economy.
- Bahrain's electricity and water minister leaves for China for talks on boosting bilateral cooperation.
